To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the meanings that emerge from within the context of communication practices are dynamic, indeterminate, and unique for each participant, and that good communication practice acknowledges this and uses it as a basis for negotiating meanings.
the meanings of sustainability emerge in the context of communication between scientists and constituents.
sustainability is a contested and ambiguous concept, and that the concept of sustainability is used in a wide range of ways by scientists, farmers and others.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: • how scientists and constituents use concepts of sustainability in their communication practices; • how these practices are shaped by the communication environment; • the implications for good communication practice in research for development; and • the role of the communication environment in shaping these practices and the implications for good research practice.
how scientists and their constituents can negotiate the meaning of sustainability.
the following questions: What is the nature of the communication environment in which sustainability is being negotiated in research for agricultural development?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
sustainability is not a single concept.
sustainability is a contested concept.
the meaning of sustainability is not fixed, and cannot be fixed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
sustainability concepts are used in the context of a unique situation and that they are not fixed in time or space.
, to improve sustainability in agricultural research for development, we must first acknowledge that it is problematic.
, in the absence of an agreed definition of sustainability, it would be useful for researchers to be able to identify and negotiate their own meanings of sustainability in the context of their work.
The main takeaway from our work is that
sustainability is an indeterminate concept that needs to be negotiated within the human communication context.
the sustainability concept is not fixed and unchangeable.
, to be effective, sustainability concepts need to be put into practice in ways that are meaningful to the people who are using them.
